gen-dafont-neon-gf-scope-one: Neon glows with tall, stamped-metal lowercase, every stroke the same width. Scope One has stubby ascenders and a big x-height, a classic serif whose counters spill open beside it.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-slabo-13px: Slabo 13px has a bookish, dignified manner, with tall a, e and s forms that stay generously open. Slabo 13px would carry a long page gently, a classic serif, while Neon glows above it.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-suwannaphum: Unvarying line weight gives Neon its glow. Suwannaphum, a dignified classic serif with an open c and high, squared-off x-height, supplies the editorial weight that makes this pairing memorable.
gen-dafont-neon-instrument-sans: Neon's lines never thicken or thin, and its tall stamped-metal lowercase glows. Instrument Sans, a plain sans with pincer-like c shapes and little step from capitals to lowercase, stays out of its way; Neon earns its keep big and short.
gen-dafont-neon-inter: Neon glows with stamped-metal lowercase and open spacing. Inter, a plain sans with hollow-reed counters and a smooth, tube-like line, would carry a long page with quiet, unfussy ease.
gen-dafont-neon-mulish: Neon brings glowing, uninterrupted lines and tall lowercase. Mulish, a modern sans-serif without any thick-and-thin modulation, has horseshoe-magnet apertures and a large x-height, so it gives the glow a friendly place to land.
gen-dafont-neon-rubik: Rubik makes its lowercase look big beside the capitals, soft and approachable. Rubik's rounded sans-serif forms sit against Neon's glowing, join-for-stem uniform lines, and the two feel like warm light on friendly paper.
gen-dafont-neuropol-fs-merriweather-sans: Slim, futuristic, pipe-bent lines. Neuropol keeps one constant stroke width, and Merriweather Sans adds tall, sturdy lowercase with a clearly open e, so give the heading a bit more size than the sans body.
gen-dafont-neuropol-fs-supreme: Futuristic and digital, Neuropol traces a single-weight outline with no swells where the eye might slow down. Supreme, a crisp sans, runs a heavier strip of text beneath it.
gen-dafont-neuropol-manrope: Sleek, digital, single-weight outline lettering. Manrope, a plain sans with bright open gaps in its curves and a modest step down from capitals, gives Neuropol's slim channels a friendly, approachable partner.
